$comment: The parts of the Rust toolchain that rustc links into OpenPaint's WebAssembly kernels (crates/opaint-cpu, wasm32-unknown-unknown): the standard library (core, alloc, std and panic_abort, from the rust-lang/rust repository), compiler_builtins (with its bundled libm), and the two crates.io crates std uses on this target, dlmalloc (its allocator) and hashbrown (its HashMap); their paths are in the .wasm's panic messages. Other std dependencies serve other targets or backtraces, which wasm32-unknown-unknown does not have. The license texts are copied unmodified from rust-lang/rust at the toolchain's commit and from the crates.io packages that its library/Cargo.lock names (checksums match). The toolchain is mise's rust@stable, so a new stable release changes these: the build warns and a unit test fails when rustc's release is not this one. To refresh, read library/Cargo.lock at the new commit and copy the texts again.
